scenes.headline: New Leave Policy 2026
scenes.narration: Good news team! Our updated 2026 leave policy makes planning time off simpler and faster for everyone.

scenes.headline: Know Your Two Leave Types
scenes.narration: There are two simple tracks. For planned vacations, apply at least three days early. If you fall sick, just ping your manager the same morning.

scenes.headline: How to Apply in 3 Steps
scenes.narration: Applying takes under a minute. Pick your dates in the HR portal, your manager gets notified automatically, and approvals wrap up within twenty-four hours.

scenes.headline: 3 Quick Rules to Remember
items: Carry forward up to 10 unused leaves
2+ sick days need a doctor's note
Check live balance anytime on HR Portal
scenes.narration: Before you go, remember three quick rules: you can carry forward up to ten unused leaves, two or more sick days need a doctor's note, and your live balance is always on the HR portal.
